description: Puerto Rico's anchorages (Culebra, Vieques, La Cordillera, the east, south and west coasts, San Juan, Mona) as 787daily's sailing hub lists them from NOAA's Coast Pilot and the cruising guides: depth, protection, moorings, hazards and reserve rules. Give windFrom (N, NE, E, SE, S, W, NW; NW reads as the file's west, 'a west or northwest wind') to get the anchorages a source calls sheltered from that wind, with the ones it calls exposed, the ones to avoid (ordnance, foul ground, a reserve) and the ones no source rates for it, by name. hurricaneHarbor: NOAA's hurricane harbors. The restricted zones (unexploded ordnance, no-anchoring areas) always come back. Cite the anchorage's url.

area.description: A region (east, north, south, west, islands) or an area, e.g. 'Culebra', 'Vieques', 'La Cordillera'

windFrom.description: Where the wind or swell comes from

name: find_anchorages
title: Anchorages sheltered from a wind
